description: This file defines a custom exception class UserAlreadyRegisteredException that extends a global exception class, used to signal that a user registration attempt failed because the user is already registered.

classes.name: UserAlreadyRegisteredException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a user is already registered.

methods.name: UserAlreadyRegisteredException
